scope: Completed isolated bitmap evaluation; timing gates not accepted, production unchanged

plan.startup: One complete context/content initialization per fresh worker process; eight warmup processes and 25 retained samples per variant, host and order. Alternate variants within each repetition; reverse their order in the reverse course. Use the existing host-cost worker initialization boundary, excluding file reads and including bundle parsing and controller creation
plan.firstForge: One rare ring, level 21, with the explicit attr_intelligence affix and random roll quality, in a fresh generator; no setup mint. The existing protocol permits explicit forging, not fillRandom
plan.steadyForge: 64 rare rings with explicit attr_intelligence and random roll quality, level 21, after one setup mint warms the same base pool. Inventory insertion outcomes and final snapshots remain checked; weighted random affix selection is covered separately by the inventory course and owner tests
plan.throughput: Reuse verified host-cost workers, their timing boundaries and exact-output checks. Eight warmups and 25 retained samples in each worker; fresh logical sessions per sample
plan.memory: Fresh native host for each variant; measure content, eight empty owners, eight identically warmed owners, after destroying owners and after host disposal. Compare incremental live bytes from content to warmed owners and report the content difference separately
plan.summary: Median, nearest-rank p95 and full range; no sample deletion. Every applicable gate in content-plan.json must pass separately for each host and both orders
plan.ambientCpu: Before each order, require all three two-second mean CPU observations to be at most 15%. If busy, record every observation and wait 15 seconds before checking again, at most three attempts. No work in that order starts until a complete observation passes. Refuse the order if all attempts fail; retain the incomplete run. This predeclared bounded wait changes no CPU, timing, sample-count or memory threshold and does not prove isolation.
plan.scope: Windows desktop experimental comparison; no target-device result, architecture selection or milestone 43 acceptance

gates.purpose: Move immutable catalogue membership work into content preparation while preserving generator ownership and exact results
gates.predecessor: The shared numeric-Set index retained exact behavior but failed cross-host timing gates. Its source and complete evidence are preserved at commit 1acdd7c.
gates.variant: Keep content-owned sparse tag postings; merge membership into bounded query-local bitmap words and visit set bits in authored order. No numeric Set or sorting; independent owner pools and random state remain unchanged.
correctness: All existing SDK tests including recorded item payloads and exact RNG/uid streams use isolated candidate outputs
Ordered pool membership matches the original for every authored base and synthetic open, explicit, empty, duplicate, reserved and excluded tags
Shared content, interleaved owners and different affinities never share mutable pools or random state
Native C++ and managed consumers retain their gameplay and ownership results
Compare empty, word-boundary, high-bit and partial-word catalogues with the original ordered-pool oracle; ensure query scratch cannot affect earlier results

timing.primary: Existing 320-command inventory course at batch 64 with a fresh logical session per sample
controls: Steady ring forging after its pool is warmed
First rare ring forge in a fresh generator
timing.policy: Both orders must pass with all samples retained. The startup control is additional; predecessor thresholds are not relaxed

memory.policy: Compare equivalent warmed owners and state, excluding separately reported content initialization. Zero tracked leaks required; this is not a device-memory budget

gates.decision: No promotion before correctness, timing controls and memory pass. Existing milestone 43 gates and target-device requirements remain separate

owners.supersedes: Version 1 exercised pool construction but omitted fillRandom, so it did not establish weighted affinity isolation

plan.purpose: Diagnostic identical-baseline comparison; cannot accept, excuse, replace or supersede a candidate performance result
plan.comparison: For each course and pair, compare independently started workers A and B loading exactly the same baseline bundle and inputs. Reverse course and label order in reverse. Retain every sample and report median/p95 changes against original control limits without an optimization verdict.

protocolRevision.reason: Two completed forward courses were followed by a busy preflight; introduce bounded prospective waiting without discarding any prior data or changing thresholds
